description: What a link becomes when somebody pastes it somewhere. The card is the whole first impression in a feed, a chat, and a message, and its absence is silent - the link still works, it just arrives as raw text.

gates.title: Every Route Carries The Open Graph Set
gates.rule: og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url and og:type on every route. A partial set is worse than none: the card renders with a gap where the image should be.
gates.fix: Set the five properties per route, or the framework's openGraph metadata object.

gates.title: og:image Is An Absolute URL
gates.rule: Every og:image is an absolute URL. The card is built by a service fetching the tag away from the page, so a relative path resolves against nothing and the image is dropped.
gates.fix: Prefix each image path with the full origin, or build it from the site URL constant.

gates.title: A Twitter Card Type Is Declared
gates.rule: twitter:card names the card shape. Without it the link falls back to a bare text row while every other link in the timeline carries an image.
gates.fix: Set twitter:card to summary_large_image, and the title, description and image alongside it.
